name: Friendly Facade
source:
Friendly Facade is a visual novel with point and click mini-games incorporated into key story moments to immerse the player in the experience. The game highlights the difficult decisions that must be made and how those decisions can have rippling effects on the other characters in this story. Every character has a deep and complex backstory, ideals, and motivations that intersect and collide with each other to form a rich, nuanced story where not everyone is able to get a happy ending. Inside the peaceful confines of the Isolated Society Study, competition, manipulation, and betrayal run rampant, and this is before the Golding Foundation intervenes, changing the rules of the game, and the fates of those 16 individuals trapped within it, forever...

Can you solve the mystery of the Golding Foundation, and dispel the facades that all 16 characters in this story use to mask their deepest, darkest secrets?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2256920/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Friendly Facade》是一款视觉小说，将点击式迷你游戏融入关键故事时刻，让玩家沉浸在体验中。游戏强调了必须做出的艰难决定，以及这些决定如何对故事中的其他角色产生连锁反应。每个角色都有深刻而复杂的背景故事、理想和动机，它们相互交叉和碰撞，形成一个丰富、微妙的故事，但并不是每个人都能得到幸福的结局。在孤立社会研究的和平范围内，竞争、操纵和背叛猖獗，而这是在戈尔丁基金会介入之前，改变了游戏规则，以及永远困在其中的16个人的命运……

你能解开戈尔丁基金会的谜团，并揭开这个故事中所有16个角色用来掩盖他们最深、最黑暗的秘密的外表吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2256920/]Steam[/url]]
